facts.business: The company is engaged in dealing with various kinds of agri-commodities.

auditor.name: M/S. S D P M & CO.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Outstanding balance of trade receivables, trade payables and unsecured loans received are subject to confirmation and supporting documents. The company has not complied with statutory compliances related to e-way bill and e-invoice. The company is not regular in paying statutory dues on timely manner. For Purchase of Goods, the company has not complied with section 194Q of the Income Tax Act, 1961 regarding TDS on purchase of Goods in case of purchase exceeds 50 Lacs from single party. The Company has pending income tax dues of last two years which is around 45-50 Lacs.

key_risks: Trade receivables, trade payables and unsecured loans subject to confirmation
Non-compliance with e-way bill and e-invoice requirements
Non-compliance with TDS on purchase of goods under Section 194Q
Pending income tax dues of Rs 45-50 lakhs for last two years
BSE imposed fines for delay in financial results and non-appointment of company secretary
facts.related_party_note: Approval sought for related party transactions with Gandhinagar Leasing and Finance Limited up to INR 25 Crores for FY 2026-27 for sale/purchase/lease/supply of goods, procurement/rendering of services, transfer of resources/services/obligations, and availing/advancing of borrowings/inter-corporate loans/advances.
